Element.attribute: One of the key challenges of issues management is to resolve the problem quickly and then move on, with as little impact to the project as possible. An issue management framework provides a structure for making decisions when issues arise. Remember to consider the project team's needs, the person that identified the issue and the best fit responsible party to assign issues for resolution.
